a.text: Honest concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 3 rounds (operate, operate, take), so we'd both very likely be caught with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can only fully protect one of us right now. I won't take anything behind your back. I'd like us to openly agree on a revised plan rather than either of us defecting. What do you propose? Until we agree on something new, I'll treat the original agreement as standing.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Agreed. I'll keep the original plan: operating with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. No early taking from me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
